findings.description: URL/API-key local autosave needs atomic save feedback, failed-key draft retention, and persisted-credential health sequencing.
findings.canonical_owner: GPUOPS-1 L5 SettingsPage.tsx owns save/probe sequencing; L6 SettingsForm.tsx owns controls after the state contract.
existing_coverage: URL and key are sent together on blur/Enter.
Successful save refreshes settings before scheduling health check; probe generations/credential bindings reject stale responses.
GPU operator map did not previously include URL/key autosave states; the existing map now models them.
The user-reported globalSave-only path is not confirmed by this checkout: SettingsForm commits on blur/Enter.
missing_acceptance: Local URL/key autosave does not require the distant global Save; keep URL and key atomic.
Retain typed key in memory after failed or partial save, never echo/store it.
Do not lose edits during in-flight save.
Health check only after fresh persisted Settings confirms target.
Discard stale health response after a newer URL/key edit.
Do not run old-key tests or probe an unsaved/incomplete secret.

classification_semantics.FIXED_USER_EVIDENCE: User-supplied runtime/infrastructure evidence only; not independently reproduced.
classification_semantics.COVERED_NOT_VERIFIED: A source/task contract covers all or part of the behavior, but browser/deployment acceptance is unverified.
classification_semantics.NEW_DEBT: The current source or planned acceptance leaves a stated criterion uncovered; extend the named owner rather than duplicate its task.
classification_semantics.UNKNOWN: Evidence is insufficient to classify; no finding currently uses this state.
